long.vo: Three hundred and sixty-one runs in five innings. An average of ninety. And the Player of the Tournament award at the Under nineteen Asia Cup. आर्यवीर सहवाग is nineteen years old, and he is the son of India's former opener, वीरेंद्र सहवाग. So the question is: is it like father, like son?

scene.kicker: U19 ASIA CUP · PLAYER OF THE TOURNAMENT
scene.title: Aaryavir Sehwag.
scene.label: runs in five innings · average 90.25

long.vo: This is Myth or Data. The claim: आर्यवीर सहवाग is just like his father. We'll test it against वीरेंद्र सहवाग's numbers, one trait at a time.

First, the tournament. Seventy not out off fifty-two against Nepal. Twenty-two against Pakistan in the group stage. A hundred and sixty against the UAE. Fifty-one in the semi-final. And fifty-eight in the final. Four dismissals, three fifties and one hundred. That is three sixty-one runs, at an average of ninety and a quarter.

scene.kicker: AARYAVIR SEHWAG · EVERY INNINGS · U19 ASIA CUP 2026
scene.title: Five innings. One hundred.

long.vo: The hundred came against the UAE, and it did not start like a सहवाग innings. He took fourteen balls to score his first run. Fifty took sixty-nine balls. The hundred, a hundred and thirty-one. Then he hit his last sixty runs off just thirty-seven balls, finishing on a hundred and sixty with seventeen fours and seven sixes.

scene.title: Fourteen balls for the first run.
scene.label: 50 off 69 balls · 100 off 131 · last 60 off 37

long.vo: Afterwards, he said he had made a promise. In his words: "I told my dad I will get a big hundred. I have a legacy to live up to, as he only likes big hundreds."

Big scores are not new for him. In November twenty twenty-four, in the कूच बिहार Trophy, he made two hundred and ninety-seven. Last month, in the विनू मांकड़ Trophy, one hundred and seventy-three off a hundred and forty-three balls. And then, in Oman, a hundred and sixty. Each of them is a सहवाग-sized innings.

rows.label: U19 Asia Cup v UAE · Nov 2026

long.vo: What is that legacy? वीरेंद्र सहवाग scored thirty-eight international hundreds: twenty-three in Tests and fifteen in one-day internationals. Two of them were Test triple centuries, with a highest of three nineteen. Eight thousand, five hundred and eighty-six Test runs at a strike rate of eighty-two, and eight thousand, two hundred and seventy-three ODI runs at a hundred and four.

scene.title: The legacy.
scene.label: 23 in Tests, 15 in ODIs · two Test triple centuries

long.vo: Test one: turning fifties into hundreds. आर्यवीर made four scores of fifty or more in the tournament, and turned one into a hundred. That is twenty-five per cent. His father, in one-day internationals, turned twenty-eight per cent: fifteen hundreds from fifty-three scores of fifty or more. Almost the same.

Test two: boundaries. Sixty-nine per cent of आर्यवीर's tournament runs came in fours and sixes: thirty-eight fours and sixteen sixes. For his father in ODIs, it was sixty-five per cent. Same shape of innings: most of the runs in boundaries.

Test three: the start. In our archive of a hundred and sixty-five of his father's one-day innings, the median wait for his first run was two balls. आर्यवीर's median, across five innings, was also two balls. Four of the five innings began within four balls. The fourteen-ball start was the exception, not the rule.

scene.kicker: BALLS FACED BEFORE THE FIRST RUN
scene.title: A father's start.

long.vo: Test four: pace. Here, the son is different. आर्यवीर's strike rate in the tournament was ninety-six. His father's in ODIs was a hundred and four. And आर्यवीर faced a dot ball fifty-eight times in every hundred, against fifty-three in our archive of his father's innings. He is slower, and he lets more balls go by.

There was one quiet game. Against Pakistan in the group stage, he made twenty-two off forty balls, and was caught at deep mid-wicket. Pakistan won by three wickets. Six days later, against the same side in the final, he made fifty-eight off sixty-one, with nine fours. His strike rate went from fifty-five to ninety-five, and his dot balls fell from sixty-eight per cent to fifty-two.

In the final, आर्यवीर played another role. He and लक्ष्य रायचंदानी put on ninety-five for the first wicket, and सहवाग made fifty-eight off sixty-one balls, with nine fours. Not a blitz. A platform. India chased three hundred and thirty-eight and won by one wicket.

scene.title: A platform, not a blitz.
scene.label: for the first wicket: Sehwag 58 off 61, Raichandani 80

long.vo: So, is आर्यवीर सहवाग just like his father? Our verdict: half busted. The appetite is the same: boundaries, big hundreds, and a fast first run. But the pace is not. He is slower, and more patient, and for a nineteen-year-old in a final, that may be exactly what India needed.
Will आर्यवीर सहवाग play for India like his father did? Tell us in the comments, and follow for more Myth or Data.

short.vo: Three hundred and sixty-one runs. An average of ninety. Player of the Tournament at the Under nineteen Asia Cup. आर्यवीर सहवाग.
He is nineteen. And his father is वीरेंद्र सहवाग: thirty-eight international hundreds, and two Test triple centuries.
After his hundred and sixty, he said: "I have a legacy to live up to." So is it like father, like son? We checked.
Test one: fifties into hundreds. He converted twenty-five per cent. His father, in ODIs, twenty-eight.
Test two: boundaries. Sixty-nine per cent of his runs, against sixty-five for his father.
Test three: the start. His father's median wait for a first run: two balls. आर्यवीर's: also two.
But the pace is different. A strike rate of ninety-six, against his father's hundred and four.
Same appetite. Different pace. Our verdict: half busted.
